description: This file defines APIs for telemetry data model objects in the COSA Data Model Library, including functions to get and set string and unsigned long parameters related to telemetry.

methods.name: Telemetry_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for telemetry configuration.

methods.name: Telemetry_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for telemetry configuration.

methods.name: Telemetry_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value for telemetry configuration.
